correctness.rationale: Cao identifies the vertical tangent with the full-stabilizer invariant harmonic degree-one space. For stable isotypic ranks \(d_\alpha\), the invariant coefficient bundle is the trace-free commutant \(\ker(\bigoplus_\alpha\operatorname{End}(E_\alpha)\to\mathcal O)\), hence has rank \(\sum d_\alpha^2-1\) and degree zero. Riemann--Roch gives Higgs-complex Euler characteristic \(-2(g-1)(\sum d_\alpha^2-1)\); Lemma 5.5 gives \(h^0=h^2=s-1\), yielding the displayed \(h^1\). The base adds \(3g-3\). The extremal type follows from convexity of squares under \(\sum d_\alpha m_\alpha=r\), with the repeated single-block case checked separately.

value.rationale: The result converts the new qualitative orbit-type stratification into a complete closed dimension formula for every stratum from its stable-isotypic ranks. The multiplicity cancellation is structural rather than a parameter substitution, and the extremal consequence identifies the unique numerical type closest in dimension to the stable locus, with an exact codimension. These dimensions are natural data for studying singular strata, Poisson leaves, and closure geometry in the joint moduli problem.
